# Copilot Instructions

## General Guidelines
- User wants NuGet vulnerability fixes for their solution
- Use bunx instead of npx to run JavaScript package CLI commands, as npm is not installed; use bunx for Context7 queries

## UI Layout Instructions
- In the Invention Comics homepage, the time and battery indicators must be placed in the top right area of the content, directly below the title bar and above the "Add Comics" button, not in the bottom footer.
- The comic library must be displayed in four columns wide, with the remaining comics in lower rows, and the action to remove a comic should be in its right-click context menu.
